# Initialize all WP33 country variables cleanly (R12 compliant).
oe_wp33_init_vars = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_active_dir } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_active_dir value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_prewar_dir } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_prewar_dir value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_war_override } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_war_override value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_auto_directives } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_auto_directives value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_auto_subsidize_themes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_auto_subsidize_themes value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_quiet_admin_mode } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_quiet_admin_mode value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_auto_war_mobilize } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_auto_war_mobilize value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_subsidized_total } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_subsidized_total value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_census_year } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_census_year value = current_year }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_cache_subjects } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_subjects value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_cache_themes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_themes value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_cache_vassals } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_vassals value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_cache_applied } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_applied value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_cache_distressed } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_distressed value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_compass_audits_count } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_compass_audits_count value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_culture_posture } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_culture_posture value = 0 }
    }
}

# Strict R12-guarded Compass audit counter increment.
oe_wp33_bump_compass_audits = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_compass_audits_count } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_compass_audits_count value = 0 }
    }
    change_variable = { name = oe_wp33_compass_audits_count add = 1 }
}

# Mutually-exclusive modifier cleaners for Tab 5 Compass briefing choices.
oe_wp33_clear_compass_colonial_mods = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_compass_colonial_charter }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_compass_colonial_charter
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_compass_colonial_mercantile }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_compass_colonial_mercantile
    }
}

# Subject scope: strip all 5 WP33 subject directive modifiers safely.

        remove_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_dir_build
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_dir_assimilate }

# Overlord scope: strip overlord-side fiscal assessment modifier safely.

    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_dir_fiscal_overlord }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_dir_fiscal_overlord
    }
}

# Overlord scope: single-pass Brebion imperial census updating O(1) cached counters.
oe_wp33_recalc_census = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
        oe_wp33_init_vars = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_census_year value = current_year }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_subjects value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_themes value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_vassals value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_applied value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_distressed value = 0 }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_wp33_is_eligible_subject = yes }
            root = {
                change_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_subjects add = 1 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_wp33_is_theme_or_march_subject = yes }
                root = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_themes add = 1 }
                }
            }
            else = {
                root = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_vassals add = 1 }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_wp33_has_any_dir_modifier = yes }
                root = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_applied add = 1 }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_wp33_is_distressed_subject = yes }
                root = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_wp33_cache_distressed add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Directive 1: Imperial Construction Drive.
oe_wp33_apply_dir_build = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
        oe_wp33_init_vars = yes
        oe_wp33_clear_overlord_directive_mods = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_active_dir value = 1 }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_wp33_is_eligible_subject = yes }
            oe_wp33_clear_subject_directive_mods = yes
            add_country_modifier = {
                modifier = oe_wp33_mod_dir_build
                years = 5
                mode = replace
            }
        }
        oe_wp33_recalc_census = yes
    }
}

# Directive 6: Cancel / Reset all active WP33 directives cleanly.
oe_wp33_apply_dir_reset = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
        oe_wp33_init_vars = yes
        oe_wp33_clear_overlord_directive_mods = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_active_dir value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_war_override value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_wp33_dir_cd }
            remove_variable = oe_wp33_dir_cd
        }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_wp33_is_eligible_subject = yes }
            oe_wp33_clear_subject_directive_mods = yes
        }
        oe_wp33_recalc_census = yes
    }
}

# Dispatch currently selected directive ID (used by Auto-Renew and Wartime Restore).
oe_wp33_dispatch_by_var = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_wp33_active_dir ?= 1 }
        oe_wp33_apply_dir_build = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_wp33_active_dir ?= 2 }
        oe_wp33_apply_dir_assimilate = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_wp33_active_dir ?= 3 }
        oe_wp33_apply_dir_convert = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_wp33_active_dir ?= 4 }
        oe_wp33_apply_dir_military = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_wp33_active_dir ?= 5 }
        oe_wp33_apply_dir_fiscal = yes
    }
}

# Strategikon Automation: Auto-Subsidize Struggling Frontier Themes/Vassals (strict gold >= 500 floor).
oe_wp33_run_auto_subsidize = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_wp33_player_eligible = yes
            var:oe_wp33_auto_subsidize_themes ?= 1
            gold >= 500
        }
        oe_wp33_init_vars = yes
        ordered_subject = {
            limit = {
                oe_wp33_is_distressed_subject = yes
                NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_wp33_mod_frontier_subsidy }
            }
            order_by = liberty_desire
            max = 3
            check_range_bounds = no
            if = {
                limit = { root = { gold >= 500 } }
                root = {
                    add_gold = -50
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp33_subsidized_total } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_subsidized_total value = 0 }
                    }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_wp33_subsidized_total add = 1 }
                }
                add_gold = 50
                add_liberty_desire = -5
                add_country_modifier = {
                    modifier = oe_wp33_mod_frontier_subsidy
                    years = 2
                    mode = replace
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Monthly human-only maintenance pulse (deduplicated per calendar month; zero AI overhead).
oe_wp33_monthly_maintenance = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_wp33_player_eligible = yes
            NOT = { var:oe_wp33_last_pulse_m ?= oe_wp33_sv_m_now }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_last_pulse_m value = oe_wp33_sv_m_now }
        oe_wp33_init_vars = yes

        # Emergency Wartime Mobilization Auto-Switch (native EU5 at_war trigger).
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_wp33_auto_war_mobilize ?= 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    at_war = yes
                    NOT = { var:oe_wp33_war_override ?= 1 }
                }
                set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_prewar_dir value = oe_wp33_sv_active_dir }
                set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_war_override value = 1 }
                oe_wp33_apply_dir_military = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    at_war = no
                    var:oe_wp33_war_override ?= 1
                }
                set_variable = { name = oe_wp33_war_override value = 0 }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_wp33_prewar_dir ?= 1 }
                    oe_wp33_apply_dir_build = yes
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_wp33_prewar_dir ?= 2 }
                    oe_wp33_apply_dir_assimilate = yes
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_wp33_prewar_dir ?= 3 }
                    oe_wp33_apply_dir_convert = yes
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_wp33_prewar_dir ?= 4 }
                    oe_wp33_apply_dir_military = yes
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_wp33_prewar_dir ?= 5 }
                    oe_wp33_apply_dir_fiscal = yes
                }
                else = {
                    oe_wp33_apply_dir_reset = yes
                }
            }
        }

        # Yearly pulse (January): Auto-Renew Directives, Auto-Subsidize Frontier Themes, and Refresh Brebion Census.
        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_wp33_auto_directives ?= 1 }
                oe_wp33_dispatch_by_var = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_wp33_auto_subsidize_themes ?= 1 }
                oe_wp33_run_auto_subsidize = yes
            }
            oe_wp33_recalc_census = yes
        }
    }
}
